name: order_bnp
description: Orders a B-type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) or NT-proBNP test. These biomarkers are released by ventricular myocardium in response to volume overload and are used for heart failure diagnosis and management.
when_to_use: Dyspnea evaluation to distinguish cardiac vs pulmonary cause
Suspected acute or chronic heart failure

examples.query: Check NT-proBNP for heart failure workup

args.clinical_indication: progressive dyspnea and lower extremity edema
